Wuthering.gg — current Aalto Tune Break entry
Version 3.0 patch-notes mirror — shared Tune Break combat mechanic
notes: The pinned roster candidate exposes exactly one current Tune Break entry for this released Character.

Version 3.0 introduced Tune Break as a shared combat mechanic: attacks build Off-Tune, a Mistune target can be hit by Tune Break for additional damage, and landing Tune Break resets Off-Tune. The character entry itself does not provide a Character skill-level damage curve.
Bellibing therefore verifies the Character-owned access/variant semantics while keeping the unmodeled shared Tune Break damage formula outside Character motion-value fields.
When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Aalto may cast Tune Break on the target. No Aalto-specific coefficient table is exposed.

mechanicsFacts.name: Forte Circuit — Resonance Mode and Trails
mechanicsFacts.triggerSummary: Aemeath operates in Tune Rupture or Fusion Burst Resonance Mode and qualifying team actions interact with the corresponding status.
mechanicsFacts.effectSummary: Tune Rupture responses inflict 10 Rupturous Trail stacks for 30 seconds, up to 30. Fusion Burst inflictions add 1 Fusion Trail for 30 seconds, up to 30. Qualifying Aemeath skills can inflict the mode status on a target; the same skill can trigger that status application on the same target once every 3 seconds. Trail consumption modifies the corresponding response/burst damage.
notes: Target trail/status transition timing is raw verified but not converted into automatic uptime or stack assumptions.

mechanicsFacts.name: Inherent Skill — Between the Stars
mechanicsFacts.triggerSummary: Team Resonators trigger the current Resonance Mode status interaction; each Resonator can trigger the stack gain once.
mechanicsFacts.effectSummary: Tune Rupture mode grants Aemeath 20% Crit DMG per trigger, up to 3 stacks; at 3 stacks Finale DMG is Amplified by 25%. Fusion Burst mode grants 30% Crit DMG per trigger, up to 2 stacks; at 2 stacks Finale DMG is Amplified by 25%. Joining the team or switching Resonance Mode resets the effect.

mechanicsFacts.name: S1 — Gilded Glimmer of the First Dawn
mechanicsFacts.triggerSummary: Active at Sequence 1. Instant Response modifies Heavy attacks; remaining out of combat and not performing Heavy Attack — Aemeath, Heavy Attack — Mech or Heavenfall Edict: Finale for over 4 seconds enters Instant Response — Brilliance. Trail-carryover branches depend on current Resonance Mode and defeated targets.
mechanicsFacts.effectSummary: In Instant Response, Heavy Attack — Aemeath and Heavy Attack — Mech gain 300% Crit DMG and continuously pull nearby targets while charging. Instant Response — Brilliance inherits Instant Response and persists outside Heavenfall Edict: Unbound; while in Brilliance but not Unbound, Charged II grants 100 Synchronization Rate. Defeating a target with Rupturous Trail/Fusion Trail enters the matching Sealed Trail for 10 seconds, records the highest defeated-target trail stack count, and the next directly damaging skill reapplies that recorded count up to the current maximum before ending Sealed Trail; Aemeath then cannot re-enter Sealed Trail for 1 second.

mechanicsFacts.effectSummary: Increases both Seraphic Duet Overture and Encore DMG Multipliers by 100%. mechanicsFacts.effectSummary: Defeating a target directly with Aemeath’s skills resets Starflux to 100%. The fatal-damage branch can trigger once every 10 minutes; reviving exits the ghost state and removes its Shield.

mechanicsFacts.effectSummary: Targets take 40% more Resonance Liberation DMG from Aemeath. mechanicsFacts.name: Tune Break — Unlanded Melody
mechanicsFacts.motionValueContext: Current Version 3.x shared Tune Break combat-system damage. The Character source entry defines availability/variant semantics but exposes no Character Lv1-Lv10 motion-value table; the shared combat-system formula is intentionally not fabricated here.

sourceLabels: wuwabuild normalized Character snapshot — exact pinned upstream commit
Prydwen — current Aemeath Tune Break entry
Version 3.0 patch-notes mirror — shared Tune Break combat mechanic
notes: The pinned roster candidate exposes exactly one current Tune Break entry for this released Character.

Version 3.0 introduced Tune Break as a shared combat mechanic: attacks build Off-Tune, a Mistune target can be hit by Tune Break for additional damage, and landing Tune Break resets Off-Tune. The character entry itself does not provide a Character skill-level damage curve.
Bellibing therefore verifies the Character-owned access/variant semantics while keeping the unmodeled shared Tune Break damage formula outside Character motion-value fields.
When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Aemeath can cast Tune Break. Pressing Normal Attack shortly afterward casts Basic Attack Stage 3.
When a team Resonator triggers Tune Break and causes Tune Rupture - Interfered, Aemeath triggers Tune Rupture Response - Starburst; the same target can be damaged by Starburst once every 8 seconds.

Starburst owns its existing source-verified Character damage fact separately. This Tune Break fact records the shared-system action and transition semantics without duplicating Starburst motion values.

mechanicsFacts.name: Ascendancy
mechanicsFacts.ruleSummary: Normal Attacks generate Ascendancy. Intro Skill restores 20%, Warrior’s Blade restores 10%, and Sword of Eternal Oath restores 40%. Full Ascendancy enables the Undying Sunlight enhanced Skill chain; Plunge consumes all Ascendancy.

mechanicsFacts.name: Crown of Wills
mechanicsFacts.ruleSummary: At S0 Crown of Wills holds up to 1 stack. A qualifying teammate Outro under Battlesong of the Unyielding grants 1 stack. Blazing Valor fully restores it out of combat. Everbright Protector removes all stacks. Sequence nodes can increase the cap and add acquisition routes.

mechanicsFacts.name: Majesty
mechanicsFacts.ruleSummary: At S0 Augusta holds up to 2 Majesty. Undying Sunlight: Plunge grants 1. Another team Resonator casting Outro while under Battlesong of the Unyielding grants 1. Sublime is the Sun requires and consumes 2 Majesty instead of Resonance Energy.

mechanicsFacts.name: Prowess
mechanicsFacts.ruleSummary: Gained when specified Basic/Heavy/Mid-air/Skill/Dodge actions deal damage. Intro Skill — Stride of Goldenflare fully restores Prowess. Full Prowess enables enhanced Heavy Attack routes and those routes consume all Prowess.

mechanicsFacts.name: S1 — Stained in Scorched Earth
mechanicsFacts.triggerSummary: Active when Augusta is at Sequence 1 or higher.
mechanicsFacts.effectSummary: Each Crown of Wills stack additionally grants 15% Crit DMG; Crown cap becomes 2; casting Intro grants 1 Crown; Undying Sunlight Strike/Leap/Plunge become immune to interruption.

mechanicsFacts.name: S2 — Cleansed in Crimson War
mechanicsFacts.triggerSummary: Active when Augusta is at Sequence 2 or higher.
mechanicsFacts.effectSummary: Each Crown of Wills stack additionally grants 20% Crit Rate. For every 1% Crit Rate over 100%, Augusta gains 2% Crit DMG, capped at +100% Crit DMG.

mechanicsFacts.name: S3 — Forged in Rot and Ruin
mechanicsFacts.triggerSummary: Active when Augusta is at Sequence 3 or higher.
mechanicsFacts.effectSummary: Increases DMG Multiplier by 25% for Thunderoar Backstep (including Dodge Counter variant), Spinslash, Uppercut, Undying Sunlight: Plunge, Sunborne and Everbright Protector.

mechanicsFacts.name: S4 — Ascent in Sun and Glory
mechanicsFacts.triggerSummary: Casting Intro Skill — Stride of Goldenflare.
mechanicsFacts.effectSummary: Increases the ATK of all Resonators in the team by 20% for 30s.

mechanicsFacts.name: S5 — Unshaken in Wrathful Tides
mechanicsFacts.triggerSummary: Applies to the shield provided by Glory's Favor.
mechanicsFacts.effectSummary: Increases the shield provided by Glory's Favor by 50%.

mechanicsFacts.name: S6 — Engraved in Radiant Light
mechanicsFacts.triggerSummary: Active at Sequence 6; additional triggers occur when Spinslash or Uppercut is performed.
mechanicsFacts.effectSummary: Crown of Wills cap becomes 4. For every 1% Crit Rate over 150%, Augusta gains another 2% Crit DMG, capped at +50%. Spinslash or Uppercut grants 2 Crown stacks at most once per 1s. Those attacks also trigger Thunder Rage at the location: two Electro-DMG instances, each equal to 100% ATK and considered Heavy Attack DMG.
notes: S6 adds the over-150% Crit conversion; it does not erase the separate S2 over-100% rule in the raw sequence text.

The exact executable per-consumed-stack versus per-cast interpretation of the base table is not guessed here; S1 is independently explicit that its extra 2.5 Resonance Energy is per 1 Concentration.

mechanicsFacts.ruleSummary:
Basic Attack
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack - Mountain Over Thunder
Hold Normal Attack to consume the highlighted Trigram - Mountain and Trigram - Thunder from left to right and cast Heavy Attack - Mountain Over Thunder, dealing Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack - Thunder Over Mountain
Hold Normal Attack to consume the highlighted Trigram - Thunder and Trigram - Mountain from left to right and cast Heavy Attack - Thunder Over Mountain, dealing a small amount of Electro DMG and additionally reducing the target's Vibration Strength.

Heavy Attack - Twin Mountains
Hold Normal Attack to consume the highlighted 2 Trigrams - Mountain from left to right and cast Heavy Attack - Twin Mountains, healing all nearby Resonators in the team.

Heavy Attack - Twin Thunders
Hold Normal Attack to consume the highlighted 2 Trigrams - Thunder from left to right and cast Heavy Attack - Twin Thunders, healing all nearby Resonators in the team once per second for 8s.

Heavy Attack - Ghost Gate Omen
When holding Normal Attack with fewer than 2 Trigrams, Buling fails the divination, becoming temporarily immobilized and losing all Trigrams and 20% of her current HP. This effect will not consume HP if Buling's current HP is below 1%.

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform Mid-air Attack, dealing Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter
Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to perform Basic Attack Stage 3, dealing Electro DMG.
- After performing Dodge Counter, press Normal Attack to perform Basic Attack Stage 4.

Trigram
Buling can hold up to 4 Trigrams. When Trigrams reach the max number, gaining new Trigrams moves all Trigrams 1 slot to the left, and the original leftmost Trigram will be removed.
- Trigram - Mountain is obtained when Basic Attack Stage 2 deals damage.
- Trigram - Thunder is obtained when Basic Attack Stage 4 or Mid-air Attack deals damage.
- Trigram - Thunder is obtained when casting Resonance Skill - In Shadow Thunder Stirs.

Heavy Attack: Scatterbloom
Use Basic Attack after Heavy Attack Chaoscleave to cast Scatterbloom to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
 
Ruby Blossom
Danjin can hold up to 120 Ruby Blossom.
Danjin obtains "Ruby Blossom" when using Resonance Skill Crimson Fragment.

mechanicsFacts.ruleSummary:
Forms Born of Heart
While in Answering Form, Hsin can gain and consume Answering Heart.
While in Illumining Form, Hsin can gain and consume Illumining Heart.

Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer
While in Answering Form, when Hsin's Answering Heart reaches 100 points, Heavy Attack - Answering Form is replaced with Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer.
Hold Normal Attack to cast the skill at the cost of STA and 100 points of Answering Heart. Hsin is immune to interruption during the action, and deals Electro DMG to the target, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Casting Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer grants Hsin Resolution of Wishes. This Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer consumes Resolution of Wishes to become Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector, dealing greater DMG. Resolution of Wishes can only be gained once every 24s.
While casting Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer or Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector, if Hsin is not in the Heart Manifest state, unlock Resonance Liberation - Formshift.

Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons
While in Illumining Form, when Hsin's Illumining Heart reaches 0 during the Mechanism Dominion state, Heavy Attack - Illumining Form is replaced with Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons.
Hold Normal Attack to cast the skill at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG to the target, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Casting Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons grants Hsin Law of Heaven. This Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons consumes Law of Heaven to become Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons, dealing greater DMG. Law of Heaven can only be gained once every 24s.
Casting Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons or Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons ends the Mechanism Dominion state and unlocks Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned
While in Illumining Form, when Hsin's Illumining Heart reaches 300 points and She is on the ground, Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned.
When Hsin is on the ground, press Resonance Skill to deal Electro DMG to surrounding targets.
Casting Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned sends Hsin into the Mechanism Dominion state.

Mechanism Dominion
The Mechanism Dominion state lasts 13s.
While this state is active, Basic Attack - Illumining Form is replaced with Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned, and Dodge Counter - Illumining Form is replaced with Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned.
When Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned or Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned hits a target, Illumining Heart is consumed if Hsin is the active Resonator.
Exiting Mechanism Dominion clears Illumining Heart.

Resonance Mode - Unison
While in Resonance Mode - Unison, Hsin gains the following effects:
- Hsin can trigger Unison Response, but not in Co-op Mode.
- After casting Intro Skill - Answering Form or Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison, the next Resonance Liberation - Formshift grants Hsin Unison for 5s.
- When Hsin triggers Unison Response, She gains Source Intent, and this cast of Intro Skill is replaced with Intro Skill - Manifold Unison, dealing greater DMG.
When Hsin casts an Intro Skill without triggering Unison Response while holding Source Intent, She consumes Source Intent instead, and the Intro Skill is replaced with Intro Skill - Manifold Unison, dealing greater DMG.
- The aforementioned effects are removed when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.
- Casting Intro Skill - Illumining Form or Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison sends Hsin directly into the Mechanism Dominion state.

Resonance Mode - Electro Flare
While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, Hsin gains the following effects:
- When Hsin enters combat, targets within a certain range do not lose Electro Flare stacks when it's triggered.
- After Resonators in the team inflict Electro Rage on a target, every 1 stacks of Electro Rage inflicted grants Hsin 1 stacks of Heart of Thunder, stacking up to 100 times, and consumes all Electro Rage stacks from that target. Heart of Thunder is removed when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.
- At the last stage of Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, Hsin actively triggers 1 instance of Electro Flare DMG on the targets. Its DMG Multiplier is equal to 35% x (the number of Heart of Thunder stacks on Hsin) x (the Electro Flare DMG Multiplier corresponding to the target's current Electro Flare stacks).
While casting Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, switching to another Resonator or ending the skill early removes the above effects.
Some time after casting Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, Hsin consumes all remaining stacks of Heart of Thunder.
When Hsin has at least 50 stacks of Heart of Thunder, Resonance Skill - Illumining Form stagnates nearby targets during the action.
- After casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift, inflict 5 stacks of Electro Flare on nearby targets within a certain range. It also makes Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned or Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned inflict Electro Flare on hit targets, up to 5 times. Casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift again resets this count. Switching Resonance Mode removes it.
Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned and Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons inflict 5 stacks of Electro Flare on the target hit. Intro Skill - Illumining Form, Intro Skill - Answering Form, and Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector inflict 1 stacks of Electro Flare on the target hit.

Unison
While Hsin is in Resonance Mode - Unison with Unison, switching to another Resonator will remove Hsin's Unison to trigger Hsin's Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill. If Hsin has full Concerto Energy and Unison at the same time, only Unison is consumed to trigger the effect.

Unison Response
While Hsin is in Resonance Mode - Unison and the active Resonator in the team has Unison, Hsin triggers Unison Response after She is switched in and casts Intro Skill, granting 1 stacks of Unison Boon to all Resonators in the team for 30s.
Hsin can only grant up to 1 stacks of Unison Boon in this way.

Unison Boon
Only the Resonators who can trigger Unison Response can gain this effect. Each stack of Unison Boon increases the total DMG dealt by Resonators who can trigger Unison Response in the team by 3%, stacking up to 2 times.

Answering Heart
Can hold up to 100 points of Answering Heart.
While in Answering Form, when Normal Attack - Answering Form, Resonance Skill - Answering Form, Intro Skill - Answering Form, or Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison hits a target, Hsin gains Answering Heart if She is the active Resonator.
Casting Intro Skill - Answering Form or Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison grants 60 points of Answering Heart.

Illumining Heart
Can hold up to 300 points of Illumining Heart.
While in Illumining Form and not in the Mechanism Dominion state, when Normal Attack - Illumining Form, Resonance Skill - Illumining Form, or Intro Skill - Illumining Form hits a target, Hsin gains Illumining Heart if She is the active Resonator.
- While in Resonance Mode - Unison, casting Intro Skill - Illumining Form or Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison directly sends Hsin into the Mechanism Dominion state and grants 300 points of Illumining Heart.
- While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, after casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift, when the Modular Heartlock generated by Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 1 is collapsed by Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 2, Heavy Attack - Illumining Form, Dodge Counter - Illumining Form, or Resonance Skill - Illumining Form, additionally gain 150 points of Illumining Heart if Hsin is the active Resonator in Illumining Form but not in the Mechanism Dominion state. This effect can only be triggered once before the next cast of Resonance Liberation - Formshift resets it, and is disabled when switched to the other Resonance Mode.
notes: Base cap only; conditional Inherent/Sequence increases remain in their separate raw source rules.

mechanicsFacts.ruleSummary:
Formshift
Casting Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer or Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector unlocks Formshift.
Cast Formshift to unfurl the Manifold Sanctum. Hsin switches to Illumining Form, unlocking a new set of combat abilities, and enters the Heart Manifest state.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
While in Illumining Form, engaging in quest dialogue, performing an environmental interaction with an animation, or using a Utility switches Hsin back to Answering Form to perform the corresponding action.
While in Illumining Form, Hsin can walk on the surface of water, and will continuously consume STA in deep water areas. In Walking Mode, Hsin in Illumining Form can step off a cliff into the air and walk slowly in mid-air, continuously consuming STA in this state. Hsin cannot restore STA while in Illumining Form and in mid-air.

Pillars Across Heaven
After casting Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons or Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons, when in Illumining Form with full Resonance Energy, Pillars Across Heaven becomes available.
Cast Pillars Across Heaven to bring the Manifold Sanctum crashing down, dealing Electro DMG to the target, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Hsin returns to Answering Form and exits the Heart Manifest state.

Edict
Casting Formshift grants Hsin 21 stacks of Edict for 45s. The effect cannot exceed 21 stacks and all stacks are removed when the duration ends.
After a Resonator on the field deals DMG, Hsin automatically consumes Edict in the following 3s to trigger the following effect up to once per second. Retriggering the effect resets the duration:
- When Edict is consumed, summon a Soaring Pillar from the Manifold Sanctum as a Coordinated Attack to strike the target once, dealing Electro DMG. 
- Edict can be automatically consumed up to 1 stack per second.
- Damage dealt by Soaring Pillar does not trigger this effect.
- When Hsin is knocked out, all Edict stacks are removed.

Heart Manifest
Increases Hsin's resistance to interruption for 45s.
Entering the Heart Manifest state resets Hsin's Illumining Form.
While in the Heart Manifest state and in Illumining Form, if Pillars Across Heaven is locked, press Resonance Liberation to have Hsin cast Invoked Form: Answering. While in Answering Form, press Resonance Liberation to have Hsin cast Invoked Form: Illumining.
Besides, if Hsin is still in Illumining Form after exiting Heart Manifest, and Pillars Across Heaven is locked, press Resonance Liberation to have Hsin cast Invoked Form: Answering.

Invoked Form: Answering
Hsin temporarily reverts to Answering Form. When this skill is cast, if Hsin is on the ground, She casts Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2; if She is in mid-air, She casts Mid-air Attack - Answering Form.

Invoked Form: Illumining

While in Illumining Form, Hsin can gain and consume Illumining Heart.

Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer
While in Answering Form, when Hsin's Answering Heart reaches 100 points, Heavy Attack - Answering Form is replaced with Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer.
Hold Normal Attack to cast the skill at the cost of STA and 100 points of Answering Heart. Hsin is immune to interruption during the action, and deals Electro DMG to the target, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Casting Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer grants Hsin Resolution of Wishes. This Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer consumes Resolution of Wishes to become Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector, dealing greater DMG. While casting Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer or Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector, if Hsin is not in the Heart Manifest state, unlock Resonance Liberation - Formshift.

Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons
While in Illumining Form, when Hsin's Illumining Heart reaches 0 during the Mechanism Dominion state, Heavy Attack - Illumining Form is replaced with Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons.
Hold Normal Attack to cast the skill at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG to the target, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Casting Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons grants Hsin Law of Heaven. This Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons consumes Law of Heaven to become Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons, dealing greater DMG. Law of Heaven can only be gained once every 24s.
Casting Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons or Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons ends the Mechanism Dominion state and unlocks Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned
While in Illumining Form, when Hsin's Illumining Heart reaches 300 points and She is on the ground, Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned.
When Hsin is on the ground, press Resonance Skill to deal Electro DMG to surrounding targets.
Casting Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned sends Hsin into the Mechanism Dominion state.

Mechanism Dominion
The Mechanism Dominion state lasts 13s.
While this state is active, Basic Attack - Illumining Form is replaced with Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned, and Dodge Counter - Illumining Form is replaced with Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned.
When Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned or Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned hits a target, Illumining Heart is consumed if Hsin is the active Resonator.
Exiting Mechanism Dominion clears Illumining Heart.

Resonance Mode - Unison
While in Resonance Mode - Unison, Hsin gains the following effects:
- Hsin can trigger Unison Response, but not in Co-op Mode.
- After casting Intro Skill - Answering Form or Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison, the next Resonance Liberation - Formshift grants Hsin Unison for 5s.
- When Hsin triggers Unison Response, She gains Source Intent, and this cast of Intro Skill is replaced with Intro Skill - Manifold Unison, dealing greater DMG.
When Hsin casts an Intro Skill without triggering Unison Response while holding Source Intent, She consumes Source Intent instead, and the Intro Skill is replaced with Intro Skill - Manifold Unison, dealing greater DMG.
- The aforementioned effects are removed when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.
- Casting Intro Skill - Illumining Form or Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison sends Hsin directly into the Mechanism Dominion state.

Resonance Mode - Electro Flare
While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, Hsin gains the following effects:
- When Hsin enters combat, targets within a certain range do not lose Electro Flare stacks when it's triggered.
- After Resonators in the team inflict Electro Rage on a target, every 1 stacks of Electro Rage inflicted grants Hsin 1 stacks of Heart of Thunder, stacking up to 100 times, and consumes all Electro Rage stacks from that target. Heart of Thunder is removed when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.
- At the last stage of Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, Hsin actively triggers 1 instance of Electro Flare DMG on the targets. Its DMG Multiplier is equal to 35% x (the number of Heart of Thunder stacks on Hsin) x (the Electro Flare DMG Multiplier corresponding to the target's current Electro Flare stacks).
While casting Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, switching to another Resonator or ending the skill early removes the above effects.
Some time after casting Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, Hsin consumes all remaining stacks of Heart of Thunder.
When Hsin has at least 50 stacks of Heart of Thunder, Resonance Skill - Illumining Form stagnates nearby targets during the action.
- After casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift, inflict 5 stacks of Electro Flare on nearby targets within a certain range. It also makes Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned or Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned inflict Electro Flare on hit targets, up to 5 times. Casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift again resets this count. Switching Resonance Mode removes it.
Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned and Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons inflict 5 stacks of Electro Flare on the target hit. Intro Skill - Illumining Form, Intro Skill - Answering Form, and Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector inflict 1 stacks of Electro Flare on the target hit.

Unison
While Hsin is in Resonance Mode - Unison with Unison, switching to another Resonator will remove Hsin's Unison to trigger Hsin's Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill. If Hsin has full Concerto Energy and Unison at the same time, only Unison is consumed to trigger the effect.

Unison Response
While Hsin is in Resonance Mode - Unison and the active Resonator in the team has Unison, Hsin triggers Unison Response after She is switched in and casts Intro Skill, granting 1 stacks of Unison Boon to all Resonators in the team for 30s.
Hsin can only grant up to 1 stacks of Unison Boon in this way.

Unison Boon
Only the Resonators who can trigger Unison Response can gain this effect. Each stack of Unison Boon increases the total DMG dealt by Resonators who can trigger Unison Response in the team by 3%, stacking up to 2 times.

Answering Heart
Can hold up to 100 points of Answering Heart.
While in Answering Form, when Normal Attack - Answering Form, Resonance Skill - Answering Form, Intro Skill - Answering Form, or Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison hits a target, Hsin gains Answering Heart if She is the active Resonator.
Casting Intro Skill - Answering Form or Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison grants 60 points of Answering Heart.

Illumining Heart
Can hold up to 300 points of Illumining Heart.
While in Illumining Form and not in the Mechanism Dominion state, when Normal Attack - Illumining Form, Resonance Skill - Illumining Form, or Intro Skill - Illumining Form hits a target, Hsin gains Illumining Heart if She is the active Resonator.
- While in Resonance Mode - Unison, casting Intro Skill - Illumining Form or Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison directly sends Hsin into the Mechanism Dominion state and grants 300 points of Illumining Heart.
- While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, after casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift, when the Modular Heartlock generated by Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 1 is collapsed by Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 2, Heavy Attack - Illumining Form, Dodge Counter - Illumining Form, or Resonance Skill - Illumining Form, additionally gain 150 points of Illumining Heart if Hsin is the active Resonator in Illumining Form but not in the Mechanism Dominion state. This effect can only be triggered once before the next cast of Resonance Liberation - Formshift resets it, and is disabled when switched to the other Resonance Mode.
notes: Base cap only; conditional Inherent/Sequence increases remain in their separate raw source rules.

mechanicsFacts.effectSummary:
Formshift
Casting Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer or Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector unlocks Formshift.
Cast Formshift to unfurl the Manifold Sanctum. Hsin switches to Illumining Form, unlocking a new set of combat abilities, and enters the Heart Manifest state.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
While in Illumining Form, engaging in quest dialogue, performing an environmental interaction with an animation, or using a Utility switches Hsin back to Answering Form to perform the corresponding action.
While in Illumining Form, Hsin can walk on the surface of water, and will continuously consume STA in deep water areas. In Walking Mode, Hsin in Illumining Form can step off a cliff into the air and walk slowly in mid-air, continuously consuming STA in this state. Hsin cannot restore STA while in Illumining Form and in mid-air.

Pillars Across Heaven
After casting Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons or Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons, when in Illumining Form with full Resonance Energy, Pillars Across Heaven becomes available.
Cast Pillars Across Heaven to bring the Manifold Sanctum crashing down, dealing Electro DMG to the target, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Hsin returns to Answering Form and exits the Heart Manifest state.

Edict
Casting Formshift grants Hsin 21 stacks of Edict for 45s. The effect cannot exceed 21 stacks and all stacks are removed when the duration ends.
After a Resonator on the field deals DMG, Hsin automatically consumes Edict in the following 3s to trigger the following effect up to once per second. Retriggering the effect resets the duration:
- When Edict is consumed, summon a Soaring Pillar from the Manifold Sanctum as a Coordinated Attack to strike the target once, dealing Electro DMG. 
- Edict can be automatically consumed up to 1 stack per second.
- Damage dealt by Soaring Pillar does not trigger this effect.
- When Hsin is knocked out, all Edict stacks are removed.

Heart Manifest
Increases Hsin's resistance to interruption for 45s.
Entering the Heart Manifest state resets Hsin's Illumining Form.
While in the Heart Manifest state and in Illumining Form, if Pillars Across Heaven is locked, press Resonance Liberation to have Hsin cast Invoked Form: Answering. While in Answering Form, press Resonance Liberation to have Hsin cast Invoked Form: Illumining.
Besides, if Hsin is still in Illumining Form after exiting Heart Manifest, and Pillars Across Heaven is locked, press Resonance Liberation to have Hsin cast Invoked Form: Answering.

Invoked Form: Answering
Hsin temporarily reverts to Answering Form. When this skill is cast, if Hsin is on the ground, She casts Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2; if She is in mid-air, She casts Mid-air Attack - Answering Form.

Invoked Form: Illumining
Hsin turns back into Illumining Form. When this skill is cast, if Hsin is on the ground, She casts Upward Cut - Illumining Form; if She is in mid-air, She casts Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form.

mechanicsFacts.effectSummary:
Forms Born of Heart
While in Answering Form, Hsin can gain and consume Answering Heart.
While in Illumining Form, Hsin can gain and consume Illumining Heart.

Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer
While in Answering Form, when Hsin's Answering Heart reaches 100 points, Heavy Attack - Answering Form is replaced with Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer.
Hold Normal Attack to cast the skill at the cost of STA and 100 points of Answering Heart. Hsin is immune to interruption during the action, and deals Electro DMG to the target, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Casting Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer grants Hsin Resolution of Wishes. This Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer consumes Resolution of Wishes to become Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector, dealing greater DMG. Resolution of Wishes can only be gained once every 24s.
While casting Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer or Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector, if Hsin is not in the Heart Manifest state, unlock Resonance Liberation - Formshift.

Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons
While in Illumining Form, when Hsin's Illumining Heart reaches 0 during the Mechanism Dominion state, Heavy Attack - Illumining Form is replaced with Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons.
Hold Normal Attack to cast the skill at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG to the target, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Casting Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons grants Hsin Law of Heaven. This Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons consumes Law of Heaven to become Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons, dealing greater DMG. Law of Heaven can only be gained once every 24s.
Casting Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons or Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons ends the Mechanism Dominion state and unlocks Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned
While in Illumining Form, when Hsin's Illumining Heart reaches 300 points and She is on the ground, Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned.
When Hsin is on the ground, press Resonance Skill to deal Electro DMG to surrounding targets.
Casting Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned sends Hsin into the Mechanism Dominion state.

Mechanism Dominion
The Mechanism Dominion state lasts 13s.
While this state is active, Basic Attack - Illumining Form is replaced with Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned, and Dodge Counter - Illumining Form is replaced with Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned.
When Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned or Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned hits a target, Illumining Heart is consumed if Hsin is the active Resonator.
Exiting Mechanism Dominion clears Illumining Heart.

Resonance Mode - Unison
While in Resonance Mode - Unison, Hsin gains the following effects:
- Hsin can trigger Unison Response, but not in Co-op Mode.
- After casting Intro Skill - Answering Form or Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison, the next Resonance Liberation - Formshift grants Hsin Unison for 5s.
- When Hsin triggers Unison Response, She gains Source Intent, and this cast of Intro Skill is replaced with Intro Skill - Manifold Unison, dealing greater DMG.
When Hsin casts an Intro Skill without triggering Unison Response while holding Source Intent, She consumes Source Intent instead, and the Intro Skill is replaced with Intro Skill - Manifold Unison, dealing greater DMG.
- The aforementioned effects are removed when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.
- Casting Intro Skill - Illumining Form or Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison sends Hsin directly into the Mechanism Dominion state.

Resonance Mode - Electro Flare
While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, Hsin gains the following effects:
- When Hsin enters combat, targets within a certain range do not lose Electro Flare stacks when it's triggered.
- After Resonators in the team inflict Electro Rage on a target, every 1 stacks of Electro Rage inflicted grants Hsin 1 stacks of Heart of Thunder, stacking up to 100 times, and consumes all Electro Rage stacks from that target. Heart of Thunder is removed when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.
- At the last stage of Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, Hsin actively triggers 1 instance of Electro Flare DMG on the targets. Its DMG Multiplier is equal to 35% x (the number of Heart of Thunder stacks on Hsin) x (the Electro Flare DMG Multiplier corresponding to the target's current Electro Flare stacks).
While casting Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, switching to another Resonator or ending the skill early removes the above effects.
Some time after casting Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, Hsin consumes all remaining stacks of Heart of Thunder.
When Hsin has at least 50 stacks of Heart of Thunder, Resonance Skill - Illumining Form stagnates nearby targets during the action.
- After casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift, inflict 5 stacks of Electro Flare on nearby targets within a certain range. It also makes Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned or Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned inflict Electro Flare on hit targets, up to 5 times. Casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift again resets this count. Switching Resonance Mode removes it.
Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned and Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons inflict 5 stacks of Electro Flare on the target hit. Intro Skill - Illumining Form, Intro Skill - Answering Form, and Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector inflict 1 stacks of Electro Flare on the target hit.

Unison
While Hsin is in Resonance Mode - Unison with Unison, switching to another Resonator will remove Hsin's Unison to trigger Hsin's Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill. If Hsin has full Concerto Energy and Unison at the same time, only Unison is consumed to trigger the effect.

Unison Response
While Hsin is in Resonance Mode - Unison and the active Resonator in the team has Unison, Hsin triggers Unison Response after She is switched in and casts Intro Skill, granting 1 stacks of Unison Boon to all Resonators in the team for 30s.
Hsin can only grant up to 1 stacks of Unison Boon in this way.

Unison Boon
Only the Resonators who can trigger Unison Response can gain this effect. Each stack of Unison Boon increases the total DMG dealt by Resonators who can trigger Unison Response in the team by 3%, stacking up to 2 times.

Answering Heart
Can hold up to 100 points of Answering Heart.
While in Answering Form, when Normal Attack - Answering Form, Resonance Skill - Answering Form, Intro Skill - Answering Form, or Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison hits a target, Hsin gains Answering Heart if She is the active Resonator.
Casting Intro Skill - Answering Form or Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison grants 60 points of Answering Heart.

Illumining Heart
Can hold up to 300 points of Illumining Heart.
While in Illumining Form and not in the Mechanism Dominion state, when Normal Attack - Illumining Form, Resonance Skill - Illumining Form, or Intro Skill - Illumining Form hits a target, Hsin gains Illumining Heart if She is the active Resonator.
- While in Resonance Mode - Unison, casting Intro Skill - Illumining Form or Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison directly sends Hsin into the Mechanism Dominion state and grants 300 points of Illumining Heart.
- While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, after casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift, when the Modular Heartlock generated by Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 1 is collapsed by Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 2, Heavy Attack - Illumining Form, Dodge Counter - Illumining Form, or Resonance Skill - Illumining Form, additionally gain 150 points of Illumining Heart if Hsin is the active Resonator in Illumining Form but not in the Mechanism Dominion state. This effect can only be triggered once before the next cast of Resonance Liberation - Formshift resets it, and is disabled when switched to the other Resonance Mode.

Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG equal to 100% of Hsin's ATK.
Hsin gains Nightglow upon entering combat or casting Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven. When Hsin casts Outro Skill, Nightglow is consumed to trigger various effects depending on the Resonance Mode She is in:
- While in Resonance Mode - Unison, Resonators in the team other than Hsin gain Shared Light when they gain Unison. After Hsin casts Outro Skill, Resonators with Shared Light gain 20% All DMG Amplification for 30s.
- While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, Resonators in the team other than Hsin gain 20% Electro DMG Amplification for 20s.
The above effects end early when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.

mechanicsFacts.name: Full Moon Domain — Lifecycle
mechanicsFacts.triggerSummary: Cast Heavy Attack - Absolute Fullness; Absolute Fullness ends Lunar Cycle and conjures Full Moon Domain at Iuno's location.
mechanicsFacts.effectSummary: Full Moon Domain lasts 30s and does not end early when Iuno leaves the field. Resonators inside the Domain periodically restore HP and STA. Recipient-specific Blessing of the Wan Light trigger/stack semantics are owned by the separate Full Moon Domain Wan Light fact.
notes: Source skill tables explicitly separate Lunar Cycle Duration 15s from Full Moon Domain Duration 30s.

sourceLabels: wuwabuild normalized Character snapshot — exact pinned upstream commit
notes: Current source tables independently list Lunar Cycle Duration = 15s and Full Moon Domain Duration = 30s; the two lifecycles must not share one duration field.
Current Wutheringlab explicitly states that Full Moon Domain lasts a fixed 30 seconds and does not end early when Iuno leaves the field.
This provenance owns only the separated Full Moon Domain lifecycle; Wan Light recipient stack semantics remain owned by iuno-full-moon-domain-wan-light-recipient.

mechanicsFacts.name: Full Moon Domain — Blessing of the Wan Light
mechanicsFacts.triggerSummary: A receiving Resonator inside Iuno's Full Moon Domain gains a Shield.
mechanicsFacts.effectSummary: That receiving Resonator gains 1 stack of Blessing of the Wan Light, at most once every 0.5s. Each stack grants 4% all DMG Amplification, up to 10 stacks. The buff lasts 10s; gaining a new stack resets the buff duration. Switching that Resonator off field removes all stacks.

mechanicsFacts.ruleSummary:
Qi Modulation
Jingran switches between the Yin Vessel and Yang Font states by casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander. Jingran is in the Yang Font state by default.

Heavy Attack - Soul Raid
When Jingran holds 300 points of Qi while in the Yin Vessel state, hold Normal Attack to consume 300 points of Qi to cast Heavy Attack - Soul Raid, dealing Fusion DMG.
After casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid, Jingran switches to the Yang Font state.
Press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander
When Jingran holds 300 points of Qi while in the Yang Font state, hold Normal Attack to consume 300 points of Qi to cast Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander, dealing Fusion DMG.
After casting Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander, Jingran switches to the Yin Vessel state.
Press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.
Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander can be cast in mid-air.

Qi
Max 300 points.
- Casting Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 3, Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 4, Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 3, or Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 4 restores 50 points of Qi.
- Casting Dodge Counter - Nether Dive, Dodge Counter - Light Watch, Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide, or Intro Skill - Question the Tombs restores 100 points of Qi.
- Casting Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls or casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander with Wayfarer's Mark restores 200 points of Qi.

Fire of Life
Max 100 points.
- Casting Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls grants 100 points of Fire of Life.
- All Fire of Life is cleared when Yinghuo ends.
While in Yinghuo, if Fire of Life is not at 0 points, casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander consumes 25 points of Fire of Life, and the DMG Multiplier of this Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander is increased based on Jingran's Max HP: The DMG Multiplier of this Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander is increased for every 1000 points of Jingran's Max HP over 25000. Up to 25000 points of Jingran's Max HP count towards this effect.

Nether to Light
- Jingran's DEF is fixed at 0.
- Jingran gains Incoming Healing Bonus based on Max HP: For every 1000 points of Max HP, Jingran receives 6.2% Incoming Healing Bonus, up to 310%.
- Jingran gains Fusion DMG Bonus based on Max HP: For every 1000 points of Max HP, Jingran receives 1.5% Fusion DMG Bonus, up to 75%.

Yang Changes, Yin Unites
Jingran gains additional ATK based on Max HP: For every 1000 points of Max HP, Jingran gains 36 additional ATK, up to 1800.
notes: Base cap only; conditional Inherent/Sequence increases remain in their separate raw source rules.

Utter Confession applies the source-listed Frazzle stack.

notes: The pinned roster candidate exposes exactly one current Tune Break entry for this released Character.

Version 3.0 introduced Tune Break as a shared combat mechanic: attacks build Off-Tune, a Mistune target can be hit by Tune Break for additional damage, and landing Tune Break resets Off-Tune. The character entry itself does not provide a Character skill-level damage curve.
Bellibing therefore verifies the Character-owned access/variant semantics while keeping the unmodeled shared Tune Break damage formula outside Character motion-value fields.
When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Phoebe may cast Tune Break on the target. No Phoebe-specific coefficient table is exposed.

In Drizzle Stance, Basic Attack and Heavy Attack restore it on hit; active Suisui casting Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance restores 100; successful Dodge - Parting Mist restores 102. Outro consumes all Floral Epistle and unlocks 0/200/400/600 threshold effects.

mechanicsFacts.name: Outer / Inner / Supernal Stellarealm
mechanicsFacts.triggerSummary: Cast End Loop to create Outer Stellarealm. The first party Intro Skill used within Outer Stellarealm evolves it into Inner Stellarealm; the second party Intro Skill used within Inner Stellarealm evolves it into Supernal Stellarealm.
mechanicsFacts.effectSummary: Outer Stellarealm heals all party members in range once every 3s with exact current Lv1-Lv10 HP-scaling values: 220+1.2%, 239+1.3%, 257+1.4%, 282+1.54%, 300+1.64%, 321+1.75%, 349+1.91%, 378+2.07%, 407+2.22%, 438+2.39%. The first party Intro Skill used within Outer Stellarealm evolves it into Inner Stellarealm. Within Inner Stellarealm's effective range, for every 0.2% of Shorekeeper's Energy Regen, all party members gain 0.01% bonus Crit. Rate, up to 12.5%; Inner Stellarealm keeps all Outer Stellarealm effects. The second party Intro Skill used within Inner Stellarealm evolves it into Supernal Stellarealm. Within Supernal Stellarealm's effective range, for every 0.1% of Shorekeeper's Energy Regen, all party members gain 0.01% bonus Crit. DMG, up to 25%; Supernal Stellarealm keeps all Inner Stellarealm effects. At S0, casting Shorekeeper's Intro Skill Discernment ends the current Stellarealm. Current realm duration is 30s.

mechanicsFacts.ruleSummary:
Resonance Skill - Decipher
When Capacity reaches 100, Resonance Skill Deduction is replaced by Resonance Skill Decipher.
Consume 100 Capacity to cast Resonance Skill Decipher, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.

Resonance Skill - Law of Reigns
When Performance Capacity reaches 5 in Intuition state, Resonance Skill Divergence is replaced by Resonance Skill Law of Reigns.
Consume 5 Performance Capacity to cast Resonance Skill Law of Reigns, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.

Mid-air Attack - Revamp
Shortly after casting Resonance Skill Decipher or Resonance Skill Divergence, use Basic Attack to perform Mid-air Attack Revamp at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.

Capacity
Xiangli Yao can hold up to 100 Capacity.
Every Normal Attack Probe on hit grants Capacity.
Every Resonance Skill Deduction on hit grants Capacity.

Performance Capacity
Xiangli Yao can hold up to 5 Performance Capacity.
When in Intuition triggered by Resonance Liberation:
Obtain 1 Performance Capacity when Stage 1 of Basic Attack Pivot - Impale hits a target.
Obtain 2 Performance Capacity when Stage 2 or 3 of Basic Attack Pivot - Impale hits a target.
Obtain 2 Performance Capacity for every Resonance Skill Divergence on hit.
Obtain 3 Performance Capacity for every Mid-air Attack Revamp on hit.
Obtain 2 Performance Capacity for every Dodge Counter Unfathomed on hit.

Resonance Skill - Decipher
When Capacity reaches 100, Resonance Skill Deduction is replaced by Resonance Skill Decipher.

Consume 5 Performance Capacity to cast Resonance Skill Law of Reigns, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.

Mid-air Attack - Revamp
Shortly after casting Resonance Skill Decipher or Resonance Skill Divergence, use Basic Attack to perform Mid-air Attack Revamp at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.

Capacity

Performance Capacity

When in Intuition triggered by Resonance Liberation:

Obtain 2 Performance Capacity when Stage 2 or 3 of Basic Attack Pivot - Impale hits a target.
Obtain 2 Performance Capacity for every Resonance Skill Divergence on hit.
Obtain 3 Performance Capacity for every Mid-air Attack Revamp on hit.
Obtain 2 Performance Capacity for every Dodge Counter Unfathomed on hit.

weaponEffects.sourceEffectText:
Grants 12% All-Attribute DMG Bonus. Casting Intro Skill or gaining a Shield as the active Resonator grants 1 stack of Nature's Order and 1 stack of Cradle of Life. This effect can be triggered via gaining a Shield once every 0.5s, stacking up to 6 times, lasting for 7s. Switching to another Resonator ends both Nature's Order and Cradle of Life immediately.
Nature's Order: Crit. DMG is increased by 4%, up to 24%. When Nature's Order reaches 6 stacks, the Crit. Rate of Heavy Attack DMG is increased by 12%.
Cradle of Life: Casting Heavy Attack consumes up to 2 stacks of Cradle of Life. For every 1 stacks of Cradle of Life consumed, Heavy Attack DMG ignores 15% of the target's DEF, up to 30%. The effect lasts for 2s.
weaponEffects.notes: Explicit unconditional self All-Attribute DMG; the existing static Build-stat contract applies.

2026-10-01 Version 3.7 source refresh: roster skill text is pinned to the current live snapshot; the upstream parameter key is now arrayString and the source audit fails closed on that exact schema.
2026-09-10 Voidwing Moth supplemental Rank-5 effect review adds the independently stated use-to-Outro incoming ATK transfer. It does not promote press/hold attack damage or assert a profile timeline.

2026-09-10 Sentry Construct damage-only review: two alternative Rank-5 ACTIVE_CAST facts share the existing exact reader/kernel. ATK/Glacio scaling is explicit for both damage entries; no Strike Capacitor, reset or freeze state is modeled.

2026-09-10 bounded supplemental review: Lorelei and Nightmare: Lampylumen Myriad each have an exact single active component. Their Wuthering Wiki Echo damage entries explicitly prove ATK scaling; per-profile provenance records the URLs and review date separately from the pinned roster inventory.

Adam Smasher Lucy/Rebecca CRIT Rate and Sigillum Aemeath Liberation bonus now use the existing static wielder-identity primitive. Their source values/restrictions were already verified; no active attack, profile rotation or recommendation is promoted.
The upstream Echo record has no dedicated skill-name field. Bellibing therefore keeps the Echo identity plus source skill description and never invents a separate skill name.
All 187 released Version 3.7 Echo records have English active-skill text, five rank parameter rows, and a source-explicit cooldown placeholder that resolves at Rank 5.

Source review completeness does not imply executable combat coverage. Damage prose is not promoted to an attack profile when scaling, hit decomposition, variants, or state semantics cannot be proven in the current attack domain.

Fallacy of No Return normal activation is a partial safe exception: Rank-5 source proves one 15.86% max-HP Spectro blast, while its hold/release variant remains explicitly outside exact execution coverage.

Nightmare: Thundering Mephis is now an exact safe attack-profile case: independent current sources resolve its Rank-5 active cast to one 405% ATK Electro hit with a 25-second cooldown. The profile cast event and timeline remain separate execution claims.

Reminiscence: Fleurdelys is now an exact safe attack-profile case: the pinned Rank-5 row proves 27.36% ATK Aero DMG x8 plus one 136.80% ATK Aero hit, with no active-cast variant ambiguity in the source record.
Structured upstream bonuses are used only where their main-slot behavior is stable. Character-restricted or loadout-replaced rows remain pending until the corresponding adapter exists.

Reminiscence: Fleurdelys is the first character-restricted structured bonus promoted: the pinned record and multilingual text resolve source token Aero to Rover (Aero), while Cartethyia is named directly. The extra +10% Aero bonus is not generalized to other Aero Resonators.
Exact Echo attack data does not close any profile active-damage dependency by itself; an executable rotation must still prove the exact Echo cast event.

patterns.summarySv: Partnernas buffs eller statusbyggande förbereds innan huvudkaraktären genomför sin skadefas.
Huvudkaraktärens arbete delas mellan flera inträden med en teammate-handoff emellan.
Fälttiden delas mellan flera skadebidrag. Vävning och kortare fönster används där referenserna stöder det.
En off-field skadefas startas; partnernas handlingar och Echo-timing samordnas medan den fortsätter.
Handoffs fördelar buffs mellan flera skadebidrag i stället för att behandla alla som en enda carry.
Referenserna beskriver medlemmarnas arbete, men underlaget väljer inte en sammanhängande teamcykel.

FIELD_WINDOW.summarySv: Karaktärens ordnade grundreferens används inom dess egen fas. Det bestämmer inte på egen hand ordningen för hela teamet.

REENTRY.summarySv: Referensen lämnar utrymme åt en partner och fortsätter när karaktären kommer tillbaka.

SHARED_WINDOW.summarySv: Den här varianten frigör fälttid eller bygger handlingar mellan partnernas faser.

SETUP.summarySv: Den här referensen förbereder första fasen eller saknar Intro; den ersätter inte automatiskt en normal loop.

PRIORITIES.summarySv: Källan anger prioriteringar snarare än en fast ordnad rotation.

proofs.claimSv: Tre-Forte-rotationen används bland annat med Iuno och Shorekeeper.
Semi-DPS-rotationen anges för Augusta/Shorekeeper när Augusta gör tre Forte utan quickswap.
Flare har en vanlig trekaraktärscykel; Electro Rover är partner och Suisui/Buling stödval.
Unison använder support–partner–Hsin–partner–Hsin; Jinhsi är nuvarande partner och Shorekeeper ett stödval.

Quickswap och buildup före Intro används med Changli för att behålla hennes kortare Outro-fönster; exakt variant beror på teamet.

En-Intro-rotationen nämns för Changli/Brant/Lupa; två Intro kan störa en teammate som behöver sin egen Intro.
Confession är hybridrotationen för Zani och har särskild setup i opener.
Partnerna måste applicera Spectro Frazzle; basic två-Nightfall och en annan variant med Spectro Rover skiljs åt.
Phrolova startar ofta först utan generalist-support och fortsätter skada off-field medan andra karaktärer bidrar.
Lucilla ändrar Skill-ordning för Phrolova; Lucilla/Qiuyuan/Phrolova nämns som ett komplett team.
I Phrolova-team ändras Echo-interruption och Cantarella stannar tills Perception Drain träffar.
Senare Jinhsi-turns utan Liberation kan behöva extra Basics/Skill; den ändringen anges inte för Carlotta.
Short burst delar fälttid med en annan skadegivare; medium burst är för en enda carry och två stöd.
Danjin och Havoc Rover anges både för hypercarry och dual-DPS; Danjins hybridreferens prioriterar Concerto.
